text: Tarbiyah (nurturing) for the generations: values, knowledge, akhlaq (character). Be a role model — your son/daughter watches, not just listens. Make du'a for them for steadfastness.

review_defects.why: The Arabic uses absolute negation (لا يسمع = does not listen), implying the child ignores words entirely. The English adds 'just', softening it to 'not only listens', which changes the intended stark contrast between actions and words.
